title: Neural network on health records predicts pancreatic cancer risk 6-18 months ahead
summary: The Prism models (a neural network, PrismNN, and logistic regression) were developed from EHR data at 55 US health care organisations, with 35,387 PDAC cases, 1,500,081 controls and 87 features per patient. PrismNN reached a test AUC of 0.826 (logistic regression 0.800), and internal-external validation AUCs of 0.740 by location, 0.828 by race and 0.789 by time. In simulated deployment at SIR 5.10, sensitivity was 35.9% at 95.3% specificity; the study is retrospective and no fully independent cohort is used.
ai_technology: Neural network (PrismNN) and logistic regression on EHR features predicting pancreatic cancer risk

evidence.tested: Internal-external validation by location, race and time, plus simulated deployment.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and effect on early detection; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A neural network predicted pancreatic cancer risk from routine health record data.
